content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Jammu Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Jammu recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIM Jammu recruitment is 24 September 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this IIM Jammu recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 12 vacancies are available for the posts of Field Investigator, Project Assistant, and Project Associate in this recruitment drive by IIM Jammu.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: For the Field Investigator post, a Graduate degree (with 60% and above) in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Social Sciences, or allied disciplines is required. A Post-Graduate degree is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the IIM Jammu recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this IIM Jammu recruitment is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this IIM Jammu recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Associate position is consolidated and can be up to Rs. 45,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts involves Application Screening followed by a decision from the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Candidates from all eligible backgrounds can apply online, provided they meet the qualification and age criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Field Investigator, Project Assistant, and Project Associate are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" heading.
